chunks: And from him, from al-Naḍr, from Mūsā ibn Bakr, who said:
Al-Fuḍayl asked him about forgetfulness, so he said: “If you doubt concerning the first two, then repeat [the salat (prayer)].”

key_terms.الْأُولَيَيْنِ: the first two units of the salat (prayer), i.e. the first two rak'ahs

ai.seo_question: What should one do if one doubts the first two rak'ahs in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding doubt in salat (prayer). It states that if a person doubts concerning the first two rak'ahs, the salat (prayer) must be repeated.
